normalized_evidence.raw_content:
Mass in the lower left breast; scattered small cysts in both breasts; bilateral internal mammary lymph nodes visualized. Please correlate with contrast-enhanced breast MRI.
Non-contrast scan: The skin surfaces of both breasts are smooth, with no obvious thickening of the skin or areolae. Neither nipple is retracted. The subcutaneous structures have clear layers. Both breasts contain abundant dense glandular tissue and are approximately symmetric. A mass is seen in the lower left breast, appearing isointense on T1W, slightly hyperintense on T2W, and slightly hyperintense on DWI. T1W and T2W show scattered punctate and round hyperintense foci in both breasts. No abnormal signal is seen in the retromammary spaces bilaterally. No obviously enlarged lymph nodes are seen in either axilla. Bilateral internal mammary lymph nodes are visualized.
